articles.title: Labour Mayor’s spending bonanza to fight “unfair rent increases”
articles.summary: The public money is being spent by Sir Sadiq Khan, Labour Mayor of London
articles.ai_summary:
- Labour Mayor Sadiq Khan launches a spending initiative to combat rising rent costs in London.  
- The initiative aims to address "unfair rent increases" affecting residents across the city.

articles.title: Insurance costs for property types revealed in new survey
articles.summary: The analysis has been undertaken. by Uswitch
articles.ai_summary:

articles.title: Rent control failures revealed in new analysis
articles.summary: The piece appears on a housing policy discussion website

articles.title: Overseas investors behind one-in-five new buy to let businesses
articles.summary: The figures come from lettings agency Hamptons
articles.ai_summary:
- Overseas investors are driving the UK buy-to-let market, accounting for 20% of new rental property businesses.  
- The data highlights a growing trend of international capital entering the UK real estate sector, as reported by lettings agency Hamptons.

articles.title: Free maintenance reporting tech for small-scale landlords
articles.summary: The offer applies only to landlord with four or fewer buy to let properties
articles.ai_summary:
- Small-scale landlords in the UK can now access free maintenance reporting technology, aimed at those with four or fewer properties.  
- This initiative is designed to simplify property management for landlords struggling with maintenance issues.

articles.title: Compulsory database ‘must be tough on rogue landlords’ says lettings boss
articles.summary: The Lettings Industry Council chief speaks out
articles.ai_summary:
- The Lettings Industry Council emphasizes the need for a stringent compulsory database to combat rogue landlords in the UK property market.
- Industry leaders are calling for stronger regulations to enhance tenant safety and accountability among landlords.

articles.title: Right to have pets has had little impact so far – claim
articles.summary: Very few landlords appear to have had a request to keep a pet
articles.ai_summary:
- A recent claim suggests the newfound right for tenants to keep pets is largely underutilized, with minimal requests from renters.  
- Landlords report little change in tenant behavior regarding pet ownership since the right was introduced.

articles.title: Build To Rent in crisis as starts plummet by 79%
articles.summary: New figures from Savills set alarm bells ringing
articles.ai_summary:
- **Dramatic Decline**: Build to Rent construction starts have plunged by 79%, signaling a potential crisis in the sector.
- **Industry Alarm**: New data from Savills raises concerns about the sustainability and future of rental property development in the UK.

articles.title: Tenants complain that landlords make it hard to charge electric cars
